If the bidder wants to avail themselves of the reservation benefit, the bidder must be the manufacturer / OEM of the offered product on GeM. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service, and Buyer will decide eligibility based on documentary evidence submitted, while evaluating the bid. Benefits of MSE will be allowed only if seller is validated on-line in GeM profile as well as validated and approved by Buyer after evaluation of documents submitted. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The following Additional Terms & Conditions shall be applicable to the procurement of the f ollowing items: 1. Flood Light 2. Webbing Sling 3. Pilot Ladder – 6 Metres 4. SIT 5. RIB Fender 6. Hydrostatic Release Unit (HRU) 1. General Technical Requirements a. All items shall be brand new, unused, genuine and of current manufacture. b. The materials shall be suitable for marine/naval applications and designed to withstand t he environmental conditions associated with shipboard and coastal operations, wherever a

pplicable. c. The supplied items shall strictly conform to the technical specifications, dimensions, capa city, material composition and performance parameters mentioned in the bid. d. The bidder shall upload technical datasheets, product catalogues, brochures and other r elevant documents to establish compliance with the offered specifications. e. Any deviation from the required specifications shall be clearly indicated in the technical b id. 2. Item-Wise Specific ATC A. FLOOD LIGHT Flood light shall be suitable for marine/industrial applications as specified in the bid. The bidder shall submit technical datasheet mentioning wattage, operating voltage, l umen output, beam angle, colour temperature and protection rating (IP). The body shall be corrosion-resistant and suitable for the specified environmental con ditions. Electrical safety and insulation requirements shall comply with applicable standards. Manufacturer's warranty certificate shall be provided. Test certificate and manufacturer's technical specifications shall be submitted wherev er applicable. B. WEBBING SLING Webbing sling shall be manufactured from high-quality synthetic webbing suitable for lifting operations. Safe Working Load (SWL/WLL), length, width and sling configuration shall be as specifi ed in the bid. The sling shall have clearly marked identification and load-bearing capacity. Manufacturer's test certificate and proof-load test certificate shall be provided. The sling shall be free from cuts, tears, damaged stitching and other visible defects. Applicable safety standards and relevant BIS/ISO requirements shall be complied with , wherever applicable. C. PILOT LADDER – 6 METRES Pilot ladder shall be of marine-grade construction and suitable for shipboard use. The overall length shall be 6 metres. The ladder shall comply with applicable SOLAS requirements, IMO recommendations and relevant marine safety standards. The bidder shall submit the manufacturer's technical datasheet and conformity certifi cate. The ladder shall have suitable steps, side ropes, proper fastening arrangements and r equired safety features. Material shall be resistant to marine environmental conditions, including moisture an d saltwater exposure. Manufacturer's identification and applicable certification shall be provided. D. SIT

The supplied SIT item shall strictly conform to the technical description, dimensions, material and intended application specified in the bid. The bidder shall submit the manufacturer's datasheet, catalogue and relevant technic al details. The item shall be suitable for the intended naval/marine application. The supplied material shall be free from manufacturing defects and physical damage. Applicable quality and conformity certificates shall be submitted wherever required. E. RIB FENDER RIB Fender shall be suitable for installation/use on Rigid Inflatable Boats (RIB) or as p er the specified application. The fender shall be manufactured from marine-grade, UV-resistant and seawater-resi stant material. The bidder shall provide details of dimensions, material, construction, mounting arran gement and compatibility. The fender shall be capable of withstanding normal operational marine conditions. The product shall be free from leakage, cracks, deformation and manufacturing defec ts. Manufacturer's technical datasheet and warranty details shall be submitted. F. HYDROSTATIC RELEASE UNIT (HRU) The HRU shall be genuine, new and suitable for the intended marine safety applicatio n. The unit shall be compatible with the specified liferaft/release arrangement and instal lation configuration. The HRU shall comply with applicable SOLAS, IMO and relevant marine safety require ments. Only approved/type-tested HRU models, as applicable to the intended equipment, sha ll be offered. The bidder shall submit valid type-approval certificate, manufacturer's datasheet and conformity certificate. Manufacturing date, expiry/replacement date and batch/serial number shall be clearly indicated. The HRU shall be supplied in original manufacturer's sealed packaging. The supplied unit shall have adequate remaining service life as prescribed by the ma nufacturer and applicable marine safety requirements. The bidder shall ensure that the HRU is compatible with the existing onboard safety e quipment. 3. Quality Assurance and Certification a. Manufacturer's Certificate of Conformity (COC), Test Certificate and Certificate of Analysi s (where applicable) shall be provided. b. All safety-critical marine equipment shall be supported by relevant statutory/type-appro val certificates, wherever applicable. c. The purchaser reserves the right to verify the authenticity of certificates from the manufa cturer or issuing authority.

4. Manufacturer Authorization In case the bidder is not the original manufacturer, the bidder shall provide valid manufactu rer authorization wherever specifically required and justified for the respective item. 5. Packaging and Identification a. All materials shall be delivered in proper original manufacturer's packaging. b. Packaging shall protect the materials against moisture, corrosion, dust, physical damage and deterioration during transportation and storage. c. Batch number, serial number, manufacturing date and expiry date shall be mentioned w herever applicable. .
